description: Converts a colour (hex, rgb(), hsl(), hwb(), hsv(), cmyk(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch(); not CSS names) to every format. With `background`, gives the WCAG 2 contrast ratio, the AA/AAA verdicts and, when it fails, the nearest colour that passes. Can add a tint/shade scale and harmonies.

scale.description: Nine tints and shades, light to dark

target.description: Contrast ratio to fix towards (default 4.5, AA for normal text)

name: color_convert
title: Colour formats and contrast
